name: Woodbrook
tagline: The old suburb turned restaurant and bar district
description: A grid of gingerbread houses west of the centre, once residential and now the city's concentration of restaurants, bars and small offices, with Ariapita Avenue running through it. It fills every weekend and is the heart of Trinidad's going out.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the city's nightlife and restaurants within walking distance
pros: Walking distance to the Savannah and the centre
Gingerbread architecture through the side streets

name: St Clair
tagline: The embassy quarter beside the Savannah
description: The most desirable residential district, on the western side of the Queen's Park Savannah, with large old houses, embassies and the Magnificent Seven, a row of extravagant colonial mansions along the park's edge. It is quiet, green and expensive.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting safety, space and the Savannah on the doorstep
pros: The Savannah for running and walking
The Magnificent Seven and the Botanic Gardens
cons: The most expensive rents in Port of Spain

name: Newtown
description: A mixed district of offices, apartment blocks and older houses sitting between St Clair and the commercial centre, with the Queen's Hall theatre and several of the city's panyards nearby. It is the practical compromise between price and position.
bestFor: Anyone wanting a central position without St Clair prices
pros: Walking distance to both the Savannah and downtown
Cheaper than St Clair for the same access
Panyards nearby in the Carnival season
cons: Mixed in character, some blocks are tired

name: Cascade and St Ann's
tagline: Up the valley, cooler and quieter
description: Residential valleys running north from the Savannah into the Northern Range foothills, with older houses, more greenery and noticeably cooler air than the flat city below. The President's House and the Botanic Gardens sit at the valley mouth.
bestFor: Anyone wanting quiet, green surroundings and a short drive to the centre
pros: Cooler and greener than the city
cons: Flash flooding in the valley after heavy rain

name: Chaguaramas
tagline: The peninsula west, with the boatyards and the islands
description: The peninsula west of the city, a former United States naval base now holding boatyards, marinas, a national park and the boats out to the Bocas islands. It is where Trinidad goes at the weekend and where the yachting community is based.
bestFor: Sailors and anyone who wants the outdoors on the city's edge
pros: Marinas, boatyards and the Bocas islands
Hiking and zip lines in the national park
cons: Twenty-five minutes from Port of Spain
Busy at weekends and empty midweek
